`final class StencilState`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.state` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [StencilState.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/state/StencilState.java)

The immutable stencil settings of the render state, comparison, reference, mask and the three operations.

## Description

The core sets it through `stencil(...)` of the [`RenderState`](/reference/pipeline/renderstate/) for the masks: a first draw writes a region into the stencil buffer, and the next draws pass only where the comparison holds.
A backend reads it from the state at each draw and maps each value to its API, such as `glStencilFunc` and `glStencilOp` or the stencil state of a pipeline.
Two equal states compare equal.
The stencil applies to the window only: the core never uses a stencil in a framebuffer.

## Creation details

<a id="StencilState-factory-of"></a>

### of

`StencilState of(StencilFunction function, int reference, int mask, StencilOperation fail, StencilOperation depthFail, StencilOperation pass)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates a state with the stencil on.
A fragment passes when `function` holds between `reference & mask` and the stored value `& mask`; `fail` applies when the comparison fails, `depthFail` when it passes but the depth test fails, and `pass` when both pass.
